name: Can recessed lighting be installed in a kitchen with a sloped ceiling?
description: Yes, recessed lighting can be installed in sloped ceilings using specific 'slope ceiling' housings and trims for proper light direction and aesthetics.

mainEntity.name: Can recessed lighting be installed in a kitchen with a sloped ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, recessed lighting can be installed in kitchens with sloped ceilings, but it requires specific types of housings and trims. Angled or 'slope ceiling' specific recessed cans are designed to sit flush with the sloped surface, ensuring the light fixture points downwards correctly. Standard cans would protrude awkwardly or direct light inefficiently. When planning, it's crucial to select the correct fixture type and consider the angle of the slope to ensure proper beam direction and aesthetic integration with the ceiling line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, recessed lighting can be installed in sloped ceilings using specific 'slope ceiling' housings and trims for proper light direction and aesthetics.
